item: Tetum stopword batch tet-2026-11-16 (field test row 64: iha, ne'ebé as rising leads)
summary: 21 Tetum closed-class words (iha, husi/hosi, kona-ba, hodi, maibé, tanba, wainhira, hafoin, hanesan, ne'e, ne'ebé and spellings, nian, ninia, tiha, daudaun, oinsá) in the global union, so hiding is retroactive at query time. Left out for global collisions: nia (India's NIA), sira, saida (Saida/Sidon), tamba, artigu, and the short words no/ho/ba/la/ka/se/o/ita/ami. Known cost: ASCII IHA in Turkish text. The rttlep.tl catalogue tag (pt) is unchanged: its Tetum/Portuguese mix is unmeasured. Arabic تصنيف not stoplisted: it is also 'credit rating' and 'ranking'.
